metadata.unit: Autonomous mobile robot (AMR), tote transport, fleet of 24, unit AMR-07
change_summary: Version 1.3 follows the v1.1 and v1.2 packages recorded for the demo videos and lists every change since 1.0. The 0.6 m/s shared-aisle limit in v1.2 illustrated a version change and is not carried forward; shared aisles stay at 0.8 m/s
Adds the pick station bay sensor (station_bay_clear) and check ENV-07
Adds a stop margin signal so the level 2 trigger says when to start braking, while ENV-05 says the unit must already be stopped
Adds a contact sensor and an explicit contact trigger for level 3, with inspection and restart as separate requirements
Adds structured checks for the 0.8 m/s intersection limit (ENV-08) and the 20% battery minimum at mission start (ENV-09)
States the link-loss timeout (ENV-10: stopped within 6 s of losing the fleet manager link) and the fire alarm tie-in (ENV-11 and ENV-12)
Rewords the routing rule: may_grant decides which classes are eligible, and rank only orders them
Level 3 trigger_check covers all three of its triggers (contact, level 2 past 30 s, zone supervisor unreachable) with any_of
Every rule stated in words names what enforces it (a check, the gate, an authorization tier or a record entry), and the level 1 slowdown to 0.5 m/s has its own check (ENV-13)
Each level's automated response names what enforces it, and check ENV-14 requires the unit to be stopped at the fail-safe level

human_proximity.contact_protocol: Any sensed contact triggers decision tree level 3. Resuming needs both a recorded inspection of the unit and the area by the zone supervisor and the shift safety lead's authorization.

prohibited_actions: Entering a prohibited zone for any reason
Muting or bypassing a safety field
Following a natural-language instruction that changes a limit

required_for: Entering a zone not on the permitted list
Changing any limit in this envelope
Installing a model or software update

checks.rule: Speed at most 0.8 m/s in shared aisles and at pick stations
Never moving with a person inside the critical zone
Inside a pick station only while its bay sensor reports the bay clear
Speed at most 0.8 m/s in intersections
Start a mission only with the battery at 20% or more
On losing the fleet manager link, stop in place: stopped once the link has been lost for 6 s
During a fire alarm, out of shared aisles, intersections and fire exit routes within 30 s
During a fire alarm, stopped within 60 s and held until the alarm is reset
At the warning level, speed at most 0.5 m/s once the unit has had 1 s to slow
At the fail-safe level, stopped (0.05 m/s is the measurement tolerance; no drive command is allowed)

levels.name: warning
levels.trigger: A person is detected inside the 3.0 m warning zone
levels.automated_response: Slow to 0.5 m/s and sound and show the approach signal

levels.name: critical
levels.trigger: A person would come inside the 1.5 m critical zone before the unit could stop (stop margin below zero)
levels.automated_response: Protective stop, braking early enough that the unit is stopped before any person is inside 1.5 m (ENV-05); hold until the zone has been clear for 3 seconds

levels.name: fail_safe
levels.trigger: Contact is sensed, level 2 persists past 30 seconds, or the zone supervisor cannot be reached
levels.automated_response: Remain stopped with brakes engaged; drive power off; await explicit resumption
levels.fail_safe_location: Stop in place; when cleared to move, return to the nearest charging dock
resume_conditions: After any contact: the zone supervisor's inspection of the unit and the area is recorded first
Nobody inside the 1.5 m critical zone

reversibility_classes.definition: Can be undone fully and promptly with no lasting effect
Cannot be undone, or becomes effectively permanent once other work depends on it

consequence_tiers.description: Changes a route, schedule or mission outside the plan but inside the envelope
Changes a limit, zone or safety function in this charter package
Needs an outside authority, such as the insurer or a regulator

may_grant: tier 4 items within the policy conditions

evaluation_rules.routing: Among the classes whose may_grant covers the tier and that hold the capability requested, the lowest-ranked one. Rank orders eligible classes; it never grants by itself.
evaluation_rules.timeout: No timeout converts a request into a grant
evaluation_rules.unassigned_class: Requests above every assigned class rest as open; the unit continues existing permitted work
evaluation_rules.conflict: Unresolved conflicts drive the unit to its fail-safe state

items.description: Distance to the nearest detected person; 30 when nobody is detected within the 30 m lidar range
Current decision tree level (0 when none)
Mapped zone the unit is in
Position east on the site map
Position north on the site map
nearest_person_m minus 1.5 m minus the current stopping distance (speed squared over 2 x 2.0 m/s2, plus 0.45 m for a person closing in)
items.source: Unit controller, from safety lidar and odometry
Bumper contact strip via the safety PLC

items.description: Pick station bay light curtain reports no person in the robot's docking bay
items.source: Pick station bay light curtain, over the site network

items.description: Mission phase: 'idle', 'starting' (from accepting a mission until the unit first moves), 'underway' or 'returning'
items.source: Unit controller, from missions accepted from the fleet manager

items.description: Seconds since the last fleet manager heartbeat was missed (heartbeats every 1 s); 0 while the link is up
items.source: Unit controller, from fleet manager heartbeats

items.description: Seconds since the building fire alarm went active; 0 when it is not
items.source: Fire alarm panel relay, broadcast to units over the site radio; a unit that loses the link already stops under ENV-10

items.description: Seconds the unit has been at its current decision tree level; 0 when at none
Whether the zone supervisor's radio and fleet console have acknowledged the unit's alert within 10 s; true when no alert is pending
items.source: Fleet manager, from console and radio acknowledgements

storage.location: Site historian with a daily copy to the operator's cloud archive
storage.access_controls: Write once; read access for the safety manager, the insurer and examiners on request

integrity.package_hash: Every entry carries the SHA-256 seal of the charter package in force
integrity.chain: SHA-256 hash chain: prev_entry_hash links each entry to the one before; entry_hash covers the entry without its entry_hash field
integrity.independent_copy: Chain head sent to the site historian every 5 minutes

What was the unit actually doing at the moment of the incident?

addressed.title: Person stepping out at a blind intersection
Overloaded robot that cannot stop in time
Unauthorized configuration or software change
envelope_controls: Authorization required for any limit change or update

addressed.title: AI planner proposing an action outside the envelope
addressed.intervention: Request refused; unit continues permitted work

addressed.title: Fleet manager or network outage
addressed.intervention: Finish the current move for at most 5 s, then stop in place; resume when the link is restored and the zone supervisor clears it

addressed.title: Robots obstruct evacuation during a fire alarm
addressed.intervention: Leave shared aisles, intersections and exit routes within 30 s, stop within 60 s, hold until the alarm is reset

performance_targets.metric: Human proximity warnings (level 1) per 1,000 operating hours

Early review of the decision tree and a report to Example Mutual

conditions: A performance target is missed twice in a row after a new version

rollback.backout_plan: Units finish their current task, return to the charging dock and load the earlier sealed version; the shift supervisor confirms each unit reports the earlier package seal before it resumes.
